title: (Senior) Supply Chain Consultant (m/w/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><img src="https://www.relexsolutions.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/relex-greenhouse-banner-top.png" alt="" width="1280" style="max-width: 100%;"></p></div><h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>Every RELEX implementation is a solution built from scratch for one customer: their processes, their data, their targets. (Senior) Supply Chain Consultants shape both sides of that build — the business processes and KPIs the customer will run on, and the configuration that makes them work in the system. Depending on your background you will lean more towards one side than the other. This is a heavily customer-facing role.<br><br></p> <h3><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Understand how the customer really plans.</strong> Prepare, facilitate and document workshops to gather and specify business requirements, and run the data analysis that shows where the strengths and the gaps actually are.</li> <li><strong>Design the target picture</strong> — planning processes, roles and the KPIs the project is measured on — and guide customers towards RELEX best practice, including where their current way of working needs to change.</li> <li><strong>Build it.</strong> Configuration, business rules, workflows and reporting that deliver the design you just agreed, and that hold up in operation: nightly run performance, scalability and maintainability, not just functional correctness.</li> <li><strong>Make the value case tangible</strong> for customer leadership: define how forecast accuracy, availability, inventory and cost will be measured, and report honestly on where we stand.</li> <li><strong>Take it live.</strong> Coordinate User Acceptance Testing, resolve what testing surfaces, and upskill super users so the customer is proficient and self-sustaining after go-live.</li> <li><strong>Own adoption, not just delivery.</strong> A technically correct solution that nobody uses is not a successful project.</li> <li><strong>Document what you built</strong> — requirements, scope and configuration — so the project team, the customer and our Continuous Services colleagues can work with it after handover.</li> <li><strong>Work across disciplines</strong>: with Technical Consultants on the data model, interfaces and the customer's ERP landscape, and with Project Managers on scope, effort and timelines.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Within RELEX</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Challenge and develop implementation best practice across industries (grocery, DIY, home goods, pharma, wholesale and more)</li> <li>Share knowledge with the team as both a trainer and a participant, and support colleagues who are earlier in their journey</li> <li>Work with our global teams on international projects and bring practices between regions</li> <li>Use AI tooling actively in your daily work — we expect curiosity here and give you room to experiment</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What we're looking for</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Around 2+ years of relevant experience</strong> in supply chain or retail planning, demand and inventory planning, or in implementing / consulting on planning software. A degree in supply chain management, business, engineering, mathematics or computer science is a good foundation — but we care more about what you have actually done.</li> <li><strong>Structured thinking and comfort with ambiguity.</strong> Many customer requirements arrive without a ready-made answer. You break them down, work with data, and arrive at a defensible recommendation.</li> <li><strong>Communication that works across levels</strong> — from super users in a training room to senior stakeholders in a steering committee, including the conversations where the message is not what the customer hoped to hear.</li> <li><strong>Business-fluent German and English.</strong> Both are used daily.</li> <li><strong>Willingness to travel</strong> depending on the project phase.</li> <li><strong>Technical affinity</strong>: SQL, scripting, or an interest to pick these up</li> </ul> <p><strong>Additionally, for the Senior level:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Several years of consulting or implementation experience, including <strong>demonstrable ownership of a workstream or a smaller project end-to-end</strong> — scope, risk, timeline and completion, not just your own tasks</li> <li>Reliable effort estimation for standard and custom requirements, supporting scoping and SOW discussions</li> <li>Experience coaching and mentoring less experienced colleagues</li> <li>Confidence in front of senior customer stakeholders, including steering committees</li> <li>Hands-on experience with a supply chain planning system, either as a user or as an implementer</li> <li>Experience defining and tracking KPIs or building a value case<br><br></li> </ul> <h3><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Who we are</span></strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We’re bold thinkers and kind teammates, growing fast but staying grounded. Our Nordic roots and global outlook shape a culture of friendliness, creativity, and collaboration, all powered by openness and shared wins. We care deeply about doing the right thing - and doing it together. </span></p> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li>Flexibility in how and where you work</li> <li>Room to thrive<strong> </strong>in a fast-growing global company with a good market position</li> <li>Practical benefits that support work, family, wellness, and everyday life</li> <li>Annual leave</li> <li>Diverse, inclusive, and supportive work culture</li> <li>Work that meaningfully reduces waste and improves sustainability</li> <li>Ownership, autonomy and flat hierarchies</li> <li>Two paid volunteering days each year</li> </ul> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are a global community of different cultures, voices, and experiences. We celebrate what makes us unique and connect through what we share, in an authentic and safe environment. Together we shape the future, and each other.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}">If you feel this is the opportunity you don’t want to miss, you can apply by sending your resume through the application form as soon as possible. Please note that we cannot process any applications through email.   <br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Apply today and be part of the future. Be RELEX!</strong></span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><img src="https://www.relexsolutions.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/relex-greenhouse-banner-bottom.jpg" alt="" width="1280" style="max-width: 100%;"></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement
description: <p><strong>Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement</strong></p> <p><em>Location: Remote</em> — this is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners. Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and industry events.</p> <p><strong>The Role </strong></p> <p>The Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement is responsible for defining and leading Acceleration Partners' data, analytics and measurement capability. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, data science, measurement, AI-enabled insights and commercial growth. The Director will work directly with enterprise clients to understand their marketing and business data ecosystem, develop measurement strategies, and help clients make better decisions through data. Internally, the role will partner with Client Services, Strategy, Sales and AI Automation teams to build AP's data capability, improve decision-making, develop new services and products, and raise data literacy across the organization. As a senior leader, the Director will also develop AP's market position as a leading authority on affiliate, influencer and partnership measurement.</p> <p><strong>Top Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>Client Measurement & Data Strategy</strong></p> <p>• Serve as AP's senior advisor on measurement, analytics and reporting.</p> <p>• Understand client data ecosystems including affiliate networks, influencer platforms, Google Analytics, CRM systems, customer databases, MMM outputs and business intelligence tools.</p> <p>• Design measurement frameworks that connect partnership marketing activity to broader business outcomes, spanning attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition and lifetime value.</p> <p>• Advise clients on how affiliate and influencer activity should be measured alongside paid media, brand marketing and broader customer acquisition strategies.</p> <p>• Own AP's point of view on measurement, partnering with MMM providers, analytics platforms and measurement vendors to keep AP at the forefront of measurement innovation.</p> <p><strong>Strategic Consulting & Problem Solving</strong></p> <p>• Lead analytical workstreams for enterprise clients, including programme audits and strategic reviews.</p> <p>• Support growth strategies, forecasting, partner valuation models and opportunity assessments.</p> <p>• Translate complex datasets into actionable commercial recommendations.</p> <p>• Partner with senior client stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics, Finance and Data Science teams.</p> <p><strong>Data Products & Capability Development • Define and own AP's data and analytics roadmap.</strong></p> <p>• Partner with Strategy and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and AI-enabled insights.</p> <p>• Lead development of scalable reporting frameworks, dashboards, benchmarking products and measurement tools.</p> <p>• Drive innovation across APVision and future analytical capabilities.</p> <p><strong>Data Enablement & Industry Thought Leadership</strong></p> <p>• Increase data literacy across Account Management, Strategy and Sales teams through training programmes, workshops and playbooks.</p> <p>• Coach teams to ask better questions, interpret data effectively and communicate insights to clients.</p> <p>• Represent AP externally as a thought leader on measurement and analytics, speaking at conferences, webinars and client forums.</p> <p>• Produce thought leadership on attribution, incrementality, MMM, AI and partnership measurement, and build relationships with key industry vendors and platforms.</p> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like:</strong></p> <p><strong>By 6 Months</strong></p> <p>The Director has built strong relationships with key enterprise client stakeholders and is actively advising on measurement strategy and programme audits. They have an established working relationship with their Data Strategist and a clear view of AP's data and analytics roadmap. Early training and enablement sessions have begun to raise data literacy across Account Management and Strategy teams.</p> <p><strong>By 1 Year</strong></p> <p>The Director is recognized internally and externally as AP's leading voice on measurement and analytics. Clients are adopting AP's measurement recommendations, and client satisfaction and retention have improved. The Director has contributed to new business wins, launched at least one new analytical product or framework, and represented AP at industry events. Data literacy and standardized analytical frameworks are visible across the organization, and the Data Strategist is developing well under their mentorship.</p> <p><strong>Qualities of the Ideal Candidate:</strong></p> <p>• Strategic thinker, comfortable operating with ambiguity</p> <p>• Strong communicator and storyteller, able to simplify complex concepts for non-technical audiences</p> <p>• Commercially minded</p> <p>• Collaborative and influential across teams and seniority levels</p> <p>• Naturally curious and innovative</p> <p>• Confident representing AP as an external thought leader</p> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications & Skills:</strong></p> <p>• 8–12+ years of experience in analytics, measurement, marketing science, consulting or data strategy</p> <p>• Experience working with enterprise clients and advising senior stakeholders and executive teams</p> <p>• Strong understanding of affiliate, influencer, digital marketing or performance marketing</p> <p>• Experience leading teams and developing talent</p> <p>• Strong understanding of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), attribution methodologies and incrementality testing</p> <p>• Proficiency with Google Analytics, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and Business Intelligence/dashboarding tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar)</p> <p>• Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and AI-enabled analytics</p> <p>• SQL and data querying experience preferred</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?</strong></p> <p>Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing.</p> <p><strong>AP PERKS & BENEFITS – WHAT WE OFFER</strong></p> <ul> <li>100% remote work for everyone </li> <li>Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits) </li> <li>401K with matching </li> <li>Open Paid Time Off </li> <li>Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December </li> <li>Volunteer and Birthday Time Off </li> <li>Focus Fridays </li> <li>Paid Parental Leave Benefits </li> <li>Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances </li> <li>Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!! </li> <li>Target base salary is £65K - £85K depending on location and experience.</li> </ul> <p>Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual's age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.</em></p> <p>  </p> <p>#LI-REMOTE  </p> <p><em>*GLSDR</em> </p> <p>#LI-MG1 </p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Services Architect 3 - Paris/London
description: <p>Datadog’s Implementation Services team helps customers implement and deploy Datadog quickly. Our team of architects leads the discovery, design, build, and launch of the Datadog platform to help customers accelerate time to value and get the most out of their investment. As a member of our team, you will be responsible for developing the technical roadmap for a customer’s implementation, and leading them through it every step of the way.   </p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</em></p> <p>What You’ll Do:</p> <ul> <li>Design and guide execution of Datadog implementations, including gathering requirements, building technical architecture, and supporting deployment and launch</li> <li>Guide customer onboarding through co-development working sessions and assist when they run into roadblocks</li> <li>Write automation and design architecture for deployment templates </li> <li>Manage the operation of implementation projects </li> <li>Collaborate with other teams, including Customer Success, Technical Account Management, and Sales to deliver an exceptional onboarding experience</li> </ul> <p>Who You Are:</p> <ul> <li>Experience designing and delivering technical solutions for DevOps Monitoring or architecture systems</li> <li>Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and compute technologies (EC2, serverless, VMware, VMs, Docker, Kubernetes).</li> <li>Experience with Config Management, IAC and CI/CD tools, including Ansible, Puppet, Terraform, Chef, Jenkins, Circle CI, GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, etc…</li> <li>Experience programming/scripting with any of the following: Java, Python, Ruby, Go, Node.JS, PHP, and .NET etc</li> <li>Successful track record with 5+ years experience as an Architect or Consultant in a professional services team</li> <li>Able to sit up to 4 hours, traveling to and from client sites </li> <li>Able to travel via auto, train or air up to 30% of the time</li> <li>Growth mindset by embracing change and AI tools</li> </ul> <p><em>Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.</em></p> <p>Benefits and Growth:</p> <ul> <li>Best-in-breed onboarding</li> <li>Generous global benefits</li> <li>Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking</li> <li>New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)</li> <li>Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing</li> <li>An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.</em></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>About Datadog: </strong></p> <p>Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Compute Libraries
description: <h4><strong>About the job</strong></h4> <p>As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll develop, maintain and release the C++ libraries and runtime APIs that engineers use to build and execute workloads on Graphcore’s AI hardware.<br>Your work will focus on developer-facing libraries, runtime components or a combination of both. You’ll design clear abstractions for low-level hardware capabilities, improve reliability and performance, and support developers integrating these libraries into the wider software stack.<br><br>You will take ownership of library changes from design and implementation through review, integration, release and ongoing maintenance. Deliver dependable library releases through packaging, dependency validation, release notes and the maintenance fixes developers need.<br><br>You’ll write API documentation, usage examples and migration guidance to help developers adopt changes confidently. Work with library users across the software stack to understand requirements, resolve integration issues and guide API improvements.</p> <h4><strong>The team and culture</strong></h4> <p>The AI Compute Libraries team develops high-performance compute libraries and the software infrastructure that helps engineers make effective use of Graphcore’s AI hardware.</p> <p>You’ll work alongside specialists in accelerator software, runtime systems and performance engineering. Together, you’ll turn hardware capabilities and developer requirements into practical, well-tested APIs, with clear documentation and dependable releases.</p> <h4><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></h4> <h4>Essential skills:</h4> <ul> <li>Strong modern C++ skills and a commitment to producing reliable, maintainable code.</li> <li>The ability to turn complex, low-level concepts into clear APIs and abstractions.</li> <li>Strong debugging and automated testing skills, including diagnosing issues in existing codebases.</li> <li>Confidence owning substantial engineering tasks independently and working effectively across teams.</li> <li>Clear written and spoken communication, with a willingness to share knowledge and support colleagues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with hardware accelerators, heterogeneous computing or architecture-specific software.</li> <li>Experience with embedded DSLs, graph representations, descriptor generation or compiler infrastructure.</li> <li>Familiarity with CMake, C++ library packaging, API/ABI compatibility, versioning or dependency management.</li> <li>Experience integrating C++ libraries with Python or ML frameworks such as PyTorch.</li> <li>Experience improving release automation, compatibility testing or developer tooling.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Benefits</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Flexible working:</strong> Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility</li> <li><strong>Generous leave:</strong> Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work</li> <li><strong>Retirement planning support:</strong> Up to 5% matched pension</li> <li><strong>Phantom equity:</strong> Share in Graphcore’s success</li> <li><strong>Workplace experience:</strong> Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day</li> <li><strong>Peace of mind protection:</strong> Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones</li> <li><strong>Electric Vehicle Scheme:</strong> Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice</li> <li><strong>Flexible benefits:</strong> Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover</li> </ul> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br><br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p><br><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.<br><br></p> <h4><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></h4> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.<br><br>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.<br><br>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.<br><br>Ready to shape the libraries developers use to build and run accelerator workloads? Apply to join Graphcore’s AI Compute Libraries team in Bristol.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Radio Frequency Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.</p> <p>Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.</p></div><h3><strong>Group Overview</strong></h3> <p>Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts. Metrea specialises in signal classification, direction finding, advanced geolocation techniques, and waveform development including waveforms for MANET and LPI/LPD applications. Metrea also develops special purpose radios for government customers and licenses DF and geolocation solutions to multiple OEMs.</p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">The Expeditionary Operations Lab, or EXOLAB, focuses on the rapid development, integration, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">evaluation</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and delivery of expeditionary capabilities within the Electromagnetic Warfare and Cyber domain.</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">EXOLAB works across research and development, experimentation, prototyping, systems integration, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">trials</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and operational delivery. The team addresses complex customer problems by combining existing technologies, emerging </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">capabilities</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and internally developed solutions into deployable systems.</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">The lab </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">operates</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> across airborne, land, maritime and dismounted environments, with a strong emphasis on practical engineering, rapid learning and delivering systems that are operationally relevant, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">supportable</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and resilient.</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW239653401 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <h3><strong>Position Summary</strong></h3> <p>We are seeking a Principal RF Engineer to lead and support the research, design, development, integration and delivery of radio-frequency systems for expeditionary Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, spectrum operations and secure communications capabilities. </p> <p>The role will be responsible for the RF engineering aspects of prototype and operational systems, including RF architecture, receiver and transmitter chains, antenna systems, signal distribution, filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, interference management and system performance analysis. </p> <p>The Principal RF Engineer will operate as a senior technical authority within a multidisciplinary team comprising electrical, systems, mechanical, software, cyber and operational specialists. The role will support the full engineering lifecycle, from concept development and technology evaluation through detailed design, integration, verification, trials, deployment and through-life support. </p> <p>This is a practical, delivery-focused engineering role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between theoretical analysis, simulation, laboratory testing, prototype development, platform integration and field trials. </p> <p>The role will be based either in Lincoln or London, with a longer-term intent to transition the primary location to London if hired initially in Lincoln. </p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Design, develop and integrate RF systems for expeditionary Unmanned Systems control, Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, spectrum-monitoring and secure communications capabilities</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Develop RF system architectures covering antennas, receivers, transmitters, amplifiers, filters, frequency conversion, switching and signal distribution</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Conduct RF performance analysis, including gain, noise figure, sensitivity, dynamic range, linearity, link budgets and interference solutions</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Integrate commercial, government and internally developed RF equipment across airborne, vehicle-mounted, maritime, fixed-site and unmanned platforms</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Plan and conduct RF testing, characterisation, fault diagnosis, verification and corrective engineering activity</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Ensure RF designs consider electromagnetic compatibility, spectrum management, grounding, bonding, shielding, environmental protection and relevant standards</span></li> <li><span description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.</p> <p>Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.</p></div><h3><strong>Position Summary</strong></h3> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW5128015 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW5128015 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph" data-ccp-parastyle-defn="{"ObjectId":"aaed607e-c2a3-5841-9fb4-41037bfa0faf|1","ClassId":1073872969,"Properties":[201342446,"1",201342447,"5",201342448,"3",201342449,"1",469777841,"Times New Roman",469777842,"Times New Roman",469777843,"Times New Roman",469777844,"Times New Roman",201341986,"1",469769226,"Times New Roman",268442635,"24",469775450,"paragraph",201340122,"2",134233614,"true",469778129,"paragraph",335572020,"1",134233118,"true",134233117,"true",469778324,"Normal"]}">The Integration Architect is an individual contributor within </span><span class="NormalTextRun SpellingErrorV2Themed SCXW5128015 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph">Metrea's</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW5128015 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph"> Platform </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW5128015 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph">Development Capability Area</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW5128015 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph">, owning the architecture, development, and support of system interfaces across the organisation's core ERP, Supply Chain, and Maintenance business applications. title: Senior Product Manager, Prediction Markets
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>Fans have opinions. Fanatics Markets lets them trade on them.</p> <p>Fanatics connects 100M+ fans with around 900 sports partners across Commerce, Collectibles, and Betting & Gaming. We’re now building Fanatics Markets, and we want it to be the biggest and best prediction market for sports, sports culture, crypto and beyond.</p> <p>Our core customer is a sports-first trader who is more likely to use Robinhood or Hyperliquid than a sportsbook. We’re building a suite of tools to give this customer the best possible trading experience from their phone. We have a small, high-performing team and a very flat structure to ensure the best ideas win.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager who is highly nimble and can solve a wide range of problems across the entire product stack. You’ll come in, understand the problem, define a solution, ship, iterate and move on to the next problem. Here are some example problems you might solve:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Building the best perpetual futures product for a sports-first trader</p> </li> <li> <p>Building a “pro” trading mode for our best customers</p> </li> <li> <p>Building industry-first tools that help traders make better decisions</p> </li> <li> <p>Building new types of rewards and incentives for traders</p> </li> <li> <p>Whatever else you come up with to drive trading volume and grow the business</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll need</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>2–6 years’ experience in Product Management</p> </li> <li> <p>A love of numbers – you think in probabilities and make data-driven decisions</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong communication skills, both written and verbal</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience delivering amazing products to end customers</p> </li> <li> <p>An entrepreneurial, high-ownership mindset</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfort with basic trading concepts and familiar with top platforms like Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood, Coinbase and Hyperliquid.</p> </li> <li> <p>You move fast</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience in fintech  or building a trading product</p> </li> <li> <p>A STEM background or quantitative degree<br><br>#LI-LS2<br><br></p> </li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. The range incorporates all of our Geographical Compensation Zones and is subject to change as the Zone associated with the actual offer is confirmed. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit <a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p> <p> </p> <p> </p></div><div class="title">Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£70,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£93,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it </em><a ----- <p></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Account Manager
description: Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact. At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses. We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart : trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive. So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops. 🚀 The Adventure Ahead As a Technical Account Manager, you’re the trusted technical engine behind our enterprise customers' greatest learning transformations! You will embed yourself as an essential strategic partner, bridging high-level customer business goals with Docebo’s cutting-edge platform capabilities. In this role, you won't just solve problems—you'll architect long-term technical strategies, pilot innovative solutions, and ensure our customers unlock maximum value to become partners for life. ⚡ The Day-to-Day Architect the Future: Translate customer business and eLearning goals into long-term, scalable technical strategies using Docebo’s robust feature set. Own the Technical Relationship: Take full technical and product ownership of your assigned enterprise accounts while collaborating closely with Account Teams on commercial growth. Serve as the Trusted Advisor: Guide executive and technical stakeholders through platform innovations, API integrations, and AI-assisted workflows to maximize operational efficiency. Proactively Protect Platform Health: Monitor technical performance metrics—like API usage and login trends—to catch and mitigate potential risks long before they hit platform stability. Lead Executive Technical Reviews: Deliver high-impact performance presentations on SLAs directly to customer leadership and champion customer feedback internally to Docebo teams. Drive Systemic Platform Improvements: Partner with Premium Advisors and internal resources to analyze support case patterns, run proof-of-concept pilot projects, and streamline overall platform health. 💪 Your Superpowers Enterprise SaaS Expertise: Bring 5+ years of SaaS technical troubleshooting and 2+ years of enterprise/large account management experience. Integration & Auth Mastery: Hold a solid foundation in back-end practices, RESTful APIs, OAuth 2.0, SAML, and front-end essentials like JavaScript, CSS, and HTML. Data & Middleware Savvy: Possess hands-on skills in at least two key areas: iPaaS tools (e.g., Workato, Zapier), SQL queries, or data warehousing/BI tools (e.g., Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI). Executive Translator: Master the art of taking complex, highly technical concepts and translating them into simple, high-value business conversations for executive decision-makers. Global Flexibility & Travel: Ready to support EMEA regional time zones and comfortable traveling internationally up to 25% of the time. Project Management Mindset: Bring proactive ownership, analytical decision-making, and experience forecasting product release impacts or advising on AI/automation integrations. 🌟 Bonus Points Cloud Certified: Possess an active AWS Product Certification. Domain Experience: Background in the e-Learning, Learning Management (LMS), or Human Capital Management (HCM) industries. Scalability Specialist: Direct experience consulting on platform performance, high availability, uptime, and enterprise scalability. Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝 Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing. Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉 Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People: Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success. Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being. Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul. Our Promise to You 😍 Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package. Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it. Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off! Family First : We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025! Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long. About Docebo 💙 At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs ( TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO ), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values— Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection —that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world. Docebo is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer . We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our workforce. All qualified applicants and employees will receive consideration for employment regardless of their race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, genetic information, or any other category protected under applicable law. As a federal contractor, Docebo is committed to the principles of affirmative action and equal employment opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Docebo does not discriminate because of protected veteran status or on the basis of disability, and Docebo takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Any individuals requiring a reasonable accommodation or would like to voluntarily disclose a disability or protected veteran status to assist with their employment application should send an e-mail to their recruiter directly. title: Field Marketing Manager
description: The way companies innovate is broken. The systems built to create and protect ideas can’t keep up with the pace of change. Today, 90% of S&P 500 company value is intangible (e.g., in intellectual property) - yet R&D and IP teams spend half their time buried in manual work , sifting through patents and paperwork instead of pushing the frontier forward. The tools of creating and protecting are stuck in the past. We’re here to fix that. Ankar is building the R&D tools for the AI era and defining what applied research will look like in the next 20 years . We’re building infrastructure and product experiences our customers rely on every day. You’ll translate messy, ambiguous problems into clean, dependable software—and you’ll do it at the cutting-edge of AI. We’re at an inflection point: We’ve raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the Founder of Hugging Face, CEO from Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI. We’re already working with the world’s most innovative companies including Fortune 500 company L’Oréal and global law firm Vorys Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market . We’re just getting started. What you'll be doing Own how Ankar shows up in the market - where we show up, what we do, and how we turn those moments into commercial outcomes. You’ll work closely with Sales and Commercial Development to build field programmes that create and accelerate pipeline. Own Field Marketing end-to-end. Lead everything from industry conferences and webinars to executive dinners, roundtables and targeted experiences. Build programmes around commercial priorities. Understand target accounts, active opportunities and pipeline gaps, and design programmes that create and accelerate demand. Partner deeply with Sales. Drive target account selection, outreach, meeting generation and fast follow-up around every programme. Build account-based experiences. Bring together events, gifting, direct outreach, digital and content to engage strategic accounts. Execute brilliantly. Creative and commercially minded, with a strong bias towards action and measurable commercial outcomes. Excellent communicator, able to work effectively across Sales, Marketing, leadership and external partners. This role is not for you if... We operate with high autonomy and ownership, expect our team to go above and beyond, be obsessed with our mission and thrive in ambiguity rather than wait for direction. You’ll own cloud posture and hardening across GCP and GKE, identity and access, security as code in our Terraform and CI/CD pipelines, detection and response, isolation of customer data in our multi-tenant platform, and the cloud-side controls around our AI features. description: <h4>About the Job:</h4> <p>The Customer Success Manager reports directly into the regional CS leader and represents LaunchDarkly as the direct point-of-contact with our customers post-sales. You’ll own building a risk mitigation strategy and coordinating across the account team to effectively steer the customer to success. </li> <li>Technical Guidance: You’ll maintain a deep level of LaunchDarkly product knowledge and be expected to provide customers with direction on implementation and adoption best practices.</li> <li>Prescriptively Sell: You maintain a pulse on how our customers are tracking against their key goals and outcomes identifying opportunities for customers to purchase additional products, services and adopt new features needed for them to maximize the value of our solution.</li> <li>Trusted Advisor: You understand your customers like no other and have built enough trust to act as an extension of their team. You thrive in a fast paced, start-up environment. </li> <li>Passion for Learning and Growth: You are enthusiastic about continuous learning and personal development at LaunchDarkly. You do not require a lot of external direction to prioritize your work. </li> <li>Highly Adaptable: You excel in a fast-paced and dynamic organizational setting.</li> <li>Strong Sales Acumen: You have a high level of sales acumen, strong negotiation skills and are eager to own a number. This is a commercially focused CS organization.</li> <li>Natural Problem Solver: You have strong critical thinking skills and enjoy the process of solving complex customer problems. You are able to escalate issues when necessary in a clear, effective manner. </li> <li>Team Player: You collaborate well with others, know when to pull specialists or leaders in and keep others informed proactively. Win as a team!</li> </ul> <h4>Qualifications:</h4> <ul> <li>5+ years in a customer-facing role, ideally in account management, customer/partner success or onboarding/implementation with a track record of exceeding targets.</li> <li>Experience owning the renewal process and being held accountable to a retention quota. This is a commercially oriented Customer Success team.</li> <li>Strong discovery and qualification skills; training in Command of the Message, MEDDIC or another sales methodology is preferred. </li> <li>Strong project management skills. You should have experience holding customers and cross-functional teams accountable to a timeline.</li> <li>Experience working on a technical product, ideally interacting with developers or other technical personas as your primary customer. Experience within the DevOps space preferred. </li> <li>Experience with both proactive and reactive customer success motions. </li> <li>We will teach you all about LaunchDarkly, but you should have an existing level of technical knowledge and know-how.</li> <li>Proven ability to advocate for both your customers and your company. You know how to be the voice of the customer in the company while mediating between the customer's requests and the company's vision.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About LaunchDarkly:</strong></h4> <p>Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations. </p> <p>The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:</p> <ul> <li>Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages</li> <li>Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts</li> <li>Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize</li> <li>Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types</li> <li>Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability</li> </ul> <p>At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. title: Director, SE
description: About Delinea: Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure. Role Overview Join Delinea as Sales Engineering Director for Northern Europe and shape how the world’s leading identity security platform is positioned and demonstrated to enterprise customers. In this role, you will build and mentor a team of 5-7 Sales Engineers across the region, develop technical strategy, and directly influence Delinea’s competitive positioning in the market. This role is based in the UK. You will report to the EMEA VP of Sales Engineering, work directly with regional leadership, and own the technical narrative for one of Delinea’s most strategic markets. This is an opportunity to lead at scale, invest in people, and help organisations embrace Zero Standing Privilege. Key Responsibilities Build and mentor the SE team Lead a team of 5-7 Sales Engineers, supporting individual development, career growth, and technical skill advancement. Establish an SE onboarding program with milestones that drive demo proficiency in 90 days or less, and embed coaching and mentorship practices across the team. Develop SE strategy and technical positioning Create a sustainable SE operating model for Northern Europe. Align technical messaging with market opportunity and competitive landscape. Identify and align KPIs with Sales Leadership so the SE function is clearly aligned to the business. Uphold demo & POC standards that include competitive trapping, Delinea value positioning, and business value alignment tailored to Northern European market requirements. Drive customer outcomes and win rates Work directly on high-value and complex deals. Support the sales team with technical validation, architecture design, and customer proof outcomes. Directly contribute to regional revenue, pipeline creation, and technical win rate targets. Partner across the organisation Establish a cross-functional program to regularly engage Product Management as Delinea’s “voice of the client,” ensuring Northern European requirements are communicated back to Product & Engineering leaders. Collaborate with Marketing and Customer Success to translate customer feedback into go-to-market opportunities. What You’ll Bring (Required) Demonstrated track record driving SE org scaling, team development, and customer outcomes across multiple markets; 2+ years management experience or equivalent impact from varied backgrounds Strong technical foundation in enterprise security, identity management, PAM, or infrastructure security Direct experience with customer POCs, demos, and solution architecture in complex enterprise sales cycles Comfortable mentoring teams through ambiguity and ownership of regional outcomes Nice-to-Have Experience in privileged access management, zero trust, or identity security space Familiarity with emerging security threats: non-human identities (NHI), AI agents, runtime authorization Experience managing distributed SE teams across multiple time zones and cultures Track record of building or improving SE organisations (ops, hiring, compensation strategy) Established relationships within Northern Europe’s cybersecurity ecosystem Familiarity with regulatory/compliance considerations across Northern European markets (GDPR, data residency) Relevant certifications: CISSP, CEH, or equivalent (not required) Why work at Delinea? We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities. We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative. What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression. At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success: Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team Ownership - We take initiative and follow through Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie. We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays. Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. In addition, all publicly posted social media sites may be reviewed. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.</p></div><h4>Role Overview:</h4> <p>This role reports to the Senior Director, People Experience EMEA and is part of the global PX team. The role will be looking after for all operational elements of HR and is part of the core foundation to the success of our HR Operating model and enables us to continue to build a smooth and efficient employee experiences. description: Badminton / Growth Sports Systems Operator 📍Location: Based anywhere in the UK 📝Contract: Full-Time, Permanent 🧳Travel: Regular travel across the UK, Europe and Internationally. There will be occasional work at our head office in Basingstoke. 📆Expected Start Date: Dec 2026 Why Hawk-Eye & Why Growth Sports❓ This exciting opportunity to join our passionate and enthusiastic team will take you to elite-level sporting events all around the world. As a member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering Hawk-Eye technology across a diverse range of current sports, including Athletics, Gaelic Sports, Volleyball, Horse Racing and Motorsports. You would be coming into a Badminton Operator role as presently, Badminton makes up the large majority of our global deployments, but our landscape can shift quickly. The 'Growth' in Growth Sports is literal: we are a highly agile department built for rapid expansion, significant pivots, and the continuous pursuit of new sporting opportunities. You will play a crucial role in maintaining excellence in our current sports, while helping us deliver innovative solutions to an ever-expanding roster of new clients. The Growth Sports department delivers our Tracking and Replay products across a wide range of sporting applications, both in the UK and globally. We are always growing and developing new cutting-edge services for our clients, and with this expansion comes the need for new faces to join our team and help drive our ongoing innovation. Successful applicants will receive training on the basic skills and knowledge required to be a Hawk-Eye operator - and then it’s time to get to an event and get immediately hands-on with our technology! We pride ourselves on supporting the development of our people, and we look forward to challenging you in a job that is truly unique. What Does A Typical Day Look Like?🛠 Pre-Match & Tournament Preparations : Liaise with key stakeholders such as broadcast personnel, match officials and other teams to ensure all contractual obligations are seamlessly delivered; Technology Setup : Set up our cutting-edge Tracking and SMART Replay technologies at venues around the world; System Checks : Conduct thorough pre-match system checks to ensure everything runs efficiently; Match-Day Operations : Monitoring and operating Hawk-Eye technologies during matches; Performance Monitoring : Keep a close eye on hardware and software, troubleshooting any issues that arise; Agile Deployment & Cross-Training: Adapt quickly to operational changes, applying your technical knowledge to new sports and systems as the department expands and pivots; Post-Match Reporting : Complete detailed reports to enhance future operations and client satisfaction; Off-Season Maintenance & Development : Build and maintain our hardware and equipment, and aid with research and development into new projects and technologies. Why Is This The Right Job For You? ✅ Passion & Innovation : Passionate about sport in general with a desire to innovate. Technical Proficiency : A strong foundation in technology with a desire to problem-solve. Agility & Adaptability: Highly resilient to change. You thrive in a dynamic environment where the primary focus can pivot rapidly from one sport to another as the business scales. Proactive Attitude : Ability to take initiative with a willingness to learn as much as possible. Time Management : Excellent time management skills to thrive in a live broadcast environment. Communication : Professional and approachable, with strong listening skills under pressure. Flexibility : Willingness to travel domestically and overseas and to work weekends. At Hawk-Eye Innovations, we appreciate and value the importance of potential and growth. If you believe that you excel in certain areas and possess the passion and desire to develop further, we encourage you to apply. What Difficulties Might I Face?🔦 Up to this point, I’m sure there have been many things that you find intriguing about the role, however, it is not without its unique challenges. Here are some that you can expect to find with the role: Dynamic & Changing Scope: Because our department is built for growth, our primary focus can shift rapidly. You must be comfortable with the unpredictability of scaling up new sports at short notice and stepping outside your comfort zone. Working Hours : Due to the nature of the sports industry, there is often work on weekends and midweek evenings and we are expected to fulfil our roles until the last kick. Travelling Abroad : You can expect to spend periods of the year working throughout Europe and internationally based on the events in the sporting calendar. High-Pressure Situations: Working in a live broadcast environment on a production that is distributed globally and widely seen by many will bring levels of pressure. All of these different factors offer different challenges daily as an operator. We will do everything we can to train you and support you to the best possible level but these factors should be considered before submitting your application. Application & Hiring Process⏳ Application: If you're interested in this position, please submit your CV and complete the application form and hit submit. Task Submission: Successful candidates from the application stage will receive invites to access our assessment system. We will ask you to complete a one-way video interview. Review Period: Once you have completed the task, our team will take a period of time to review it and provide application updates. Assessment Event: Successful candidates from the video interview will be invited to one of our Hawk-Eye Assessment Events. Offers & Feedback : The team will take time to review all feedback and conduct our final reviews. All candidates will receive detailed feedback from the assessment event whether they have been successful or not as we appreciate each candidate's desire for development. We look forward to receiving your application and exploring how you can contribute to the future of sports entertainment at Sony Sports. title: Senior SecOps Engineer
description: What is Flagstone? Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work. Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage. A feel for our culture: To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth. That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it. We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three. But enough about us. Let’s talk about you. About the role We’re looking for a Senior SecOps Engineer to take ownership of security operations at Flagstone. That covers everything from alert triage and incident response through to detection engineering and continuous improvement of how our SOC works. This is a hands-on role that sits right at the operational end of security. You’ll spend real time in the alert queue, as well as building the detections and automation that make it better. You’ll be right in the middle of complex investigations and P1s, while also shaping how the function operates. You’ll also own our relationship with our managed SOC provider, setting the standards they work to rather than simply receiving their output. About the team You’ll sit within Security Engineering, reporting to our Security Team Leader. In this role you’ll own detection, triage and incident response, and act as the technical counterpart to our managed SOC provider. That means directing their scope, holding them to clear detection and response standards, and keeping ownership of anything escalated or high severity in house. Does this sound like you? You’re an engineer at heart. You’d rather write the detection than describe it, and you treat detections and automation like any other engineering work: version controlled, tested and documented. You’re the go to expert when something serious happens, and you can explain security risk just as clearly to engineers as to senior stakeholders. You’re curious about new technology, AI included, and you have a clear view on where it genuinely helps and where it introduces risk. What you’ll do You’ll take ownership of our SOC operations and report on their performance and health to stakeholders across the business. You’ll run investigations and incident response for complex or high severity alerts, managing parallel workstreams, keeping stakeholders informed and running post incident reviews through to real changes in detections or process. You’ll own the detection engineering backlog, building, tuning and retiring detections across Microsoft Sentinel and Defender, mapped to a coverage model such as MITRE ATT&CK. You’ll turn threat intelligence into detection logic and hunting activity, and drive our automation and SOAR maturity by building Logic App playbooks that reduce manual effort without losing judgement on the nuanced cases. You’ll manage our managed SOC relationship day to day: defining scope and escalation criteria, reviewing performance against SLAs and acting as the technical escalation point for anything they can’t close. You’ll keep playbooks, escalation paths and documentation in shape so the practice scales beyond any one person, and you’ll track metrics like triage time, false positive rate and coverage gaps to drive continuous improvement. You’ll also explore and introduce AI assisted tooling into SOC workflows, such as triage and enrichment copilots, detection authoring and alert summarisation, where it clearly makes a difference, with sensible boundaries on where human judgement stays in the loop. What you’ll bring 5+ years in a SOC, security operations or detection engineering role, with progression into a senior IC position Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel and Defender, building detections rather than just consuming alerts Experience running investigations and incident response, including communicating with stakeholders under pressure Experience building SOAR and automation content (for example Sentinel Logic Apps), including monitoring for silent failure A strong grasp of attack patterns and MITRE ATT&CK, and how to turn them into a detection coverage model Experience directing a managed or outsourced SOC or MDR provider, setting scope, SLAs and escalation criteria Practical experience applying AI or LLM tooling to SecOps work Strong communication and stakeholder skills, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders Critical thinking and a real curiosity for new technologies and frameworks It would be great if you also have Experience in regulated financial services Exposure to identity centric detection (Entra ID) and cloud native threat detection GCIH, GCFA or an equivalent hands-on IR or detection certification Links to the SOC and detection engineering community, through conferences, speaking or open source detection content such as Sigma rules How we reward you: At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits: Hybrid working - Spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you. A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods. Around the World scheme - 3 months work from anywhere scheme Mental wellbeing support – Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill Learning and development – £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role. Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind Matched pension contributions up to 5% 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days Enhanced Parental Leave – enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay. All are welcome. At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background.
