title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team is a highly specialized, customer-facing software engineering team at Databricks. We work with Databricks most strategic customers to design, build, and productionize first-of-their-kind data and AI solutions.  This team is the right fit for you if you love working side-by-side with customers, collaborating with teammates, and pushing your curiosity across the latest trends in data, applications, and AI innovation.</p> <p><strong>Role Description</strong></p> <p>As a <strong>Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)</strong>, you will embed directly with our most strategic customers to design and deliver custom fullstack applications and solutions on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform and other common software stacks. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for software engineers, developers, and builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for solving complex problems that drive measurable outcomes.</p> <p><strong>The impact you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own the Architecture:</strong> Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.</li> <li><strong>Application Engineering:</strong> Design and develop applications spanning backend, frontend, and integrations, bringing data and AI to life for enterprise users leveraging the Databricks platform. </li> <li><strong>Solution Delivery:</strong> Deliver production-grade systems from data ingestion and transformation through ML/AI model integration to user-facing applications and enablement.</li> <li><strong>Customer Immersion:</strong> Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Partner with Sales, Product, and Field Engineering to ensure a seamless customer journey from pre-sales through post-deployment.</li> <li><strong>Reusable Assets & Scale:</strong> Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Engineering Depth:</strong> Strong background in software engineering with experience across backend, frontend, and systems integration. Proficiency in Python, SQL, Java/Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks.</li> <li><strong>Application Delivery:</strong> Demonstrated ability to design, build, and deploy production applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.</li> <li><strong>AI/ML Experience:</strong> Familiarity working with AI APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini into applications, and leveraging AI code generation tools to accelerate productivity. </li> <li><strong>Customer Impact:</strong> Proven track record of delivering technical solutions in enterprise environments that drive measurable outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration & Communication:</strong> Ability to engage across a broad stakeholder range, from engineers to C-level executives, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.</li> <li><strong>Learning Mindset:</strong> Curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies, domains, and customer challenges.</li> <li>Ability and interest to travel up to 50% as needed to client sites.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/databricks">X</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@Databricks">YouTube</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/databricksinc/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong></span>At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ/edit?usp=sharing">here</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p>At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.</p> <p><strong>Compliance</strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.</span></strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Planning, UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3833 - Director, Planning, UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p><strong>About WPP 650                      </strong></p> <p>Join an award-winning team at the heart of UK government, where your work will genuinely shape lives. As part of WPP 650 you’ll be part of a supportive, collaborative environment that values curiosity, kindness, and growth. Together, we use behaviour change pinciples to design smarter services, influence better decisions, and help millions of people across the country.</p> <p>Named WPP 650, after the 650 UK constituencies, the name is a reminder that our work must reflect the full breadth of the country, every community, every audience. No two days are the same. The challenges are complex, the problems worth solving, and the learning constant. You’ll tackle issues that matter, alongside talented colleagues who care deeply about what they do. It’s demanding – but always rewarding.</p> <p>WPP 650 is a bespoke agency unit within WPP, dedicated to serving the evolving communications needs of government clients. We bring together the best of WPP's talent, technology, and insights to deliver impactful, modern, and effective public communications. We are at the forefront of reimagining how government engages with its citizens.</p> <p>This is meaningful work with real-world impact – the kind you can point to with pride.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p><em> </em>The planning team are the guardians of creating industry leading, unrivalled work at WPP 650. We are central conduits to all specialists, striving to push boundaries and have a positive impact on consumers and brand.</p> <p>WPP 650 is looking for a <strong>Planning Director</strong> to join our growing planning team, to drive planning across specific clients and be a media planning expert.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <p><strong>Media planning craft:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop an advanced understanding of media channels, channel ecosystems and planning best practices.</li> <li>Start to translate strategic approach into planning practices for specific client briefs and pitches.</li> <li>Have an advanced understanding of WPP 650’s Consumer Journey thinking and planning philosophy across all client work. Including being an expert in a broad set of internal tools, as well as external tools to build a deep understanding of the consumer, the client’s business and its specific opportunities.</li> <li>Have an expert overview of the media market landscape, trends and start to build media owner relationships.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Campaign management & effective communication:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Oversee campaign management, ensuring quality control and output is of the highest standard.</li> <li>Develop a skilled understand of commercial practises and of the wider agency.</li> <li>Build and maintain client and agency relationships at a mid-senior level, to ensure a comprehensive understanding of stakeholders and client business.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Comms planning and storytelling: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Own planning presentations including defining the inputs needed and working with the wider teams to compile work and meet deadlines.</li> <li>Lead brainstorm and idea creation for campaigns</li> <li>Start to independently problem solve, including integrating and questioning data and insights and find solutions based on knowledge and experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Core skills:</strong></p> <p><strong>Practice Area Knowledge -Skilled-</strong> Develops breadth and depth of industry understanding. Becomes confident using tools, technology, techniques and systems and is able to train others. Comfortable presenting both direct from platform (Open) and developing a story from data but delivered outside of platform (Telmar etc). Can confidently answer client questions and liaise with internal teams on best solutions to use.</p> <p><strong>Problem Solving – Skilled</strong> - Uses critical questioning and maintains a broad perspective when analyzing information to gain a deeper understanding of the problem and wider impact. Quickly generates appropriate solutions informed by previous experience. Understands how to resolve escalated issues and supports others to problem solve. Supports or leads troubleshooting communication for issues.</p> <p><strong>Stakeholder Relationships – Skilled</strong> - Has an expert knowledge of client and agency structures. Can identify key decision makers and understands their perspectives which is used to build relationships. Has strong knowledge of the client sector/industry which is shared to build strategies and plans. Identifies strategic issues and raises questions to help stakeholders explore and understand their wider business challenges. ​​​​​​​ Can easily suggest business solutions to match client/stakeholder needs and achieve objectives.</p> <p><strong>Effective Communication -Advanced-</strong> Leads the delivery of relevant and accurate information to drive maximum impact. Consistently delivers communications to influence and educate all levels of seniority, appropriately judging the demands of the situation. Creatively develops presentations and comms to help with the understanding/education of complex information. Guides others on the best practices and approaches for creating clear, concise and organized communication materials to convey plans in a user-friendly way.</p> <p><strong>Campaign Management – Advanced -</strong> Reviews the work of others to ensure accuracy and thoroughness objectives have been met; provides coaching on ways to improve work outputs.  Applies best practice to campaign management and acts as the escalation point for issues.  Provide actionable insights during mid and post campaign reports to improve in-flight optimizations and future campaign brief recommendations.  Oversees team members to discuss current projects, workload and activities prioritises resources accordingly.  Improves workload management by supporting other in setting priorities and by postponing less relevant work.</p> <p><strong>Compelling Storytelling – Skilled -</strong> Applies big picture thinking in work and proactively leverages an understanding of the organization and key industry trends.  Understand the different elements of responses.  Designs differentiated communications (content focus, style, presentation etc) for various internal and external audiences.</p> <p><strong>Ideas Creation – Advanced -</strong> Lead new projects/activities that can create ideas to deliver effective solutions to clients’ business objectives.  Ability to proactively generate ideas to provoke and deliver against broader business strategies.  Coaches others to gain new insights and view opportunities from different perspectives.  Championing an environment that fosters innovation by encouraging others to openly share and build on other’s new ideas, products and solutions</p> <p><strong>Comms Planning – Skilled -</strong> Applies knowledge of client, audience, channel, market and category to effectively deliver compelling multi-media plans.  Translates learnings and trends to create marketing communication strategies that are effective with clear measurement.   Application of purchase journey thinking and visualization of how the media plan works channels.  Translation of strategic direction/platform/provocation into directional role for media, channel role and behaviour in channel.  Identifies and recommends budget shifts as campaign is in-flight where appropriate.</p> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em></p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking

title: Lead Enterprise Account Executive, Defense and Public UK&I
description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="elementToProof"> <p>Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.</p> </div></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p><strong><em>Lead at the forefront of AI & Data Resilience</em></strong></p> <p>At Veeam, we don’t just talk about the future of technology — we are actively shaping it. We are a global leader in data resilience, operating at the epicentre of the AI, cloud and security evolution. Our culture is built by forward-thinking technologists with heart: people who challenge convention, collaborate openly, and believe that great ideas can come from anywhere.</p> <p>Joining Veeam means being part of a business that combines the energy and agility of a start-up with the scale, credibility, and market leadership of a global technology powerhouse. We focus relentlessly on customer outcomes, empower our teams to own their destiny, and create an inclusive environment where every voice matters.</p> <p><strong><em>Why Veeam</em></strong></p> <p>Work at the heart of AI-driven data resilience, enjoy flexibility and outcome-based performance, and lead with autonomy in a globally recognized organization that invests deeply in its people, culture, and leadership.</p> <p><strong><em>The Opportunity</em></strong></p> <p>This is a pivotal growth role within Veeam’s UK & Ireland organization.</p> <p>As Lead Account Executive, Enterprise you will be responsible for a book of existing key customers in the Defense sector, Public accounts and a set of target enterprise accounts to hunt and close net new logo acquisition. You will drive a daily rhythm to ensure in quarter execution and build forward pipeline. You will develop a clear point of view on the market and a constant curiosity to link corporate objectives and technology initiatives with customer and partners alike. You will set and manage the strategy for your Territory working with specialist teams in the UK & Ireland and Inside Sales and Sales Development teams based in Bucharest.</p> <p>Reporting to the Director of Enterprise, UK & Ireland, you will play a central role in shaping how Veeam engages customers, partners, and the market — accelerating growth while building a culture of excellence, collaboration, and innovation.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the vision for your UK & Ireland Enterprise Territory</li> <li>Coordinate virtual, geographically distributed teams</li> <li>Drive disciplined sales execution across the full Veeam portfolio</li> <li>Accelerate growth in hybrid cloud and cloud-native environments</li> <li>Build executive-level relationships with senior stakeholders</li> <li>Challenge the status quo with bold, innovative ideas</li> <li>Partner with Channel, Hyperscalers, and System Integrators</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>What Success Looks Like</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Sustained revenue growth and increased wallet share</li> <li>Strong operational excellence and predictable execution</li> <li>High-trust, high-performance sales culture</li> <li>Deep, long-term customer and partner relationships</li> <li>A future-ready, scalable Enterprise Territory</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></p> <p>You are a seasoned Enterprise Sales Account Manager with presence, energy, and ambition. You bring a proven track record of leading go-to-market strategy and execution in complex technology environments, deep understanding of data resilience and cloud ecosystems, and an inspirational style to coordinate and excite virtual teams.</p> <p><strong><em>Experience & Qualifications</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree in business or technical discipline (or equivalent experience)</li> title: Senior Brand Designer
description: Senior Brand Designer OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! BRAND CREATIVE @ CARWOW Brand Creative is the central creative studio for all brands within the Carwow Group. We’re an ambitious team who thrive on storytelling, craft and collaboration. We bring our portfolio of brands to life across every channel; from large-scale campaigns to social-first paid marketing creative, events, brand identity, commercial initiatives and internal culture-building. We move quickly, adapt often and work closely with colleagues across the whole business. Due to the scale up nature of the business you’ll enjoy a unique mix of variety, ownership and creative exploration. YOUR MISSION Your mission is to elevate how our brands show up visually; taking ownership of everything from early creative concepts to final delivery across a wide mix of channels. As the sole permanent designer in the team, you will play a central role in shaping how we communicate visually, balancing conceptual thinking with hands-on craft, and ensuring our brands remain consistent, recognisable and creatively ambitious. You will support onboarding and coaching our freelancers in the guidelines and internal systems, taking ownership of both. You’ll collaborate closely with marketing, content, product and editorial teams, while being confident operating independently, solving problems proactively and bringing structure to a fast-moving creative environment. You’ll also be an active contributor to our Creative Community, helping connect, inspire and align creatives across the wider business (there are plenty of creative pockets at Carwow Group!). KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Deliver high-quality design across brand, campaign, social, print, CRM, paid media and editorial channels. Partner with the Head of Creative, Creative Strategist and Copywriters to develop clear, insight-led creative ideas and campaign directions. Interpret brand guidelines pragmatically, knowing when to follow, when to adapt and when to propose improvements. Produce assets that scale: layouts, toolkits, templates and visual systems that support efficiency across the group. Concept and create social-first paid video content that reflects platform behaviours and audience expectations, particularly across YouTube and Meta. Work with Product Designers to ensure brand and campaign creative translates effectively into digital journeys. Present your work with clarity, explaining rationale, constraints, and the impact of design decisions. Provide constructive, objective feedback to freelancers and ensure their work aligns with brand expectations. Bring structure and consistency to design delivery through thoughtful file organisation, templating and process improvements. Contribute actively to Carwow’s Creative Community, sharing inspiration, collaborating across teams and helping strengthen our creative culture. Proactively explore AI solutions in the creative workflow without compromising on execution. KEY REQUIREMENTS A strong portfolio showcasing both concept development and crafted design across digital and print, preferably including a 360 campaign from ATL to tactical performance assets. Proficiency in Figma, Illustrator, InDesign and Photoshop, with consistent attention to detail. Ability to create coherent campaign executions, from early concepts to multi-channel rollouts. Experience adapting design to fit channel needs, especially across social and performance environments. Comfortable collaborating creatively with copywriters and stakeholders, and able to offer clear, thoughtful feedback. Self-sufficient, organised and proactive, confident managing multiple projects without heavy oversight. Strong understanding of visual trends, social formats and the role of motion in brand expression. A natural collaborator who enjoys working across disciplines and connecting with other creatives. BONUS POINTS Motion design capability (After Effects + Premiere Pro) Interest or experience in shooting UGC-style short form content Illustration or iconography skills An interest in creative operations, workflow improvements or building toolkits (including AI solutions) INTERVIEW PROCESS Introductory call with our Talent team Step one: Video call with Head of Creative (30 mins) Step two: Concepting or design task presented to two members of the Brand Creative team (1 hr) Step three: Interview with our Brand and Comms Director (30 mins) Default on all JDs: WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU Competitive compensation package 28 days’ holiday + bank holidays (up to 35 with service) Share options Pension via Royal London (up to 5% company contribution) Bupa private healthcare Life assurance (4x salary) Monthly wellbeing coaching with Spill Inclusive parental leave policies Bubble childcare support & discounted nanny fees Work-from-abroad scheme Generous learning & development budget £500 / €550 home office budget Diversity and inclusion are integral to our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, and treat all applicants fairly and equally. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception. As Financial Crime Oversight & Remediation Manager, you will provide that ownership. You will coordinate targeted oversight of higher-risk or strategically important merchant relationships, helping turn concerns into clear, proportionate and evidenced plans. You will work across Compliance, Financial Crime Investigations, onboarding, commercial and operational teams, and, where appropriate, directly with merchants. Your judgement will matter: you will need to know when a proposed control or remediation is credible, when evidence is insufficient, and when an issue needs escalation. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines financial crime compliance expertise with strong delivery discipline. You will help address issues early, support defensible decisions, and give complex remediation the structure and follow-through it needs. What you’ll do Own targeted remediation coordination. For complex merchant concerns, bring together the relevant internal teams, clarify the problem and desired outcomes, agree accountable owners and milestones, and maintain a practical plan through to closure. Track dependencies and slippage, challenge gaps, escalate material blockers and confirm that completion is supported by evidence. Coordinate Compliance-imposed conditions. Track material financial-crime conditions attached to product, market or other approval decisions. Work with the relevant Compliance and business owners to confirm accountability, milestones and evidence of completion; identify slippage or gaps; challenge whether evidence demonstrates the condition has been met; and escalate overdue or inadequately evidenced actions through the agreed governance route. The relevant delivery owner remains accountable for implementing the condition. Coordinate enhanced oversight of merchants. Support a structured watch-list approach for merchants whose risk or control environment warrants closer attention than routine, risk-tiered monitoring, but where immediate termination or a formal investigation is not necessarily the right response. Help define the oversight plan, review progress and ensure concerns do not remain unresolved or without an owner. Assess remediation quality. Review proposed actions and evidence against the underlying financial crime concern and relevant regulatory expectations. Identify whether controls appear appropriately designed and operating, whether further evidence or testing is needed, and whether residual concerns require escalation or a change in the relationship’s risk treatment. Engage merchants constructively. Where appropriate, work with account teams to agree clear requests, expectations and timelines with merchants. Maintain a firm, evidence-led approach while supporting a proportionate path to address weaknesses and establish whether the relationship can be sustained safely. Lead enhanced control reviews. Design and, where appropriate, lead deeper reviews of a merchant’s AML controls during onboarding or ongoing oversight. This may include preparing agendas, conducting structured discussions with merchant stakeholders, probing key control areas, documenting findings and agreeing any required remediation. Support reliance and outsourcing assessments. Contribute to the initial scrutiny of outsourced activities or other arrangements that depend on another party’s controls. Help establish whether reliance is justified, what evidence supports that view, and what conditions or remediation are required. Improve the oversight approach. Capture recurring issues, lessons and delivery gaps, and help refine processes, reporting and escalation so that complex concerns receive consistent, timely and well-evidenced attention. What you’ll bring Experience in financial crime compliance, AML, or a closely related risk and control role, with a sound understanding of AML control frameworks and how to assess their design and effectiveness. Experience coordinating complex remediation, regulatory or audit actions, control reviews, investigations follow-through, or comparable cross-functional change. You can turn an ambiguous issue into a sequenced plan with clear owners, milestones and evidence of completion. The confidence and judgement to challenge senior stakeholders and merchants constructively, distinguish a credible response from a paper commitment, and escalate when progress or evidence is inadequate. Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to lead structured discussions, document findings clearly and translate complex issues into practical actions. Excellent organisation and follow-through across multiple workstreams, with a pragmatic approach to prioritisation, dependencies and changing circumstances. A collaborative style and the resilience to work through sensitive, commercially significant issues without losing sight of the control outcome. Experience with structured project management methods, such as Lean Six Sigma or PRINCE2, to drive organised execution across complex workstreams is a strong plus. Experience with complex merchants, payments, cryptoassets, money service businesses, correspondent or outsourced service models would be valuable. Relevant professional qualifications are welcome but are not a substitute for sound judgement and demonstrated delivery. Success is visible in the quality of the decisions and the fact that agreed actions are actually completed. title: Anthropic Research Resident
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>The Anthropic Residency is our paid, fixed-term research program, with placements lasting between six weeks and six months. We are looking for people who have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields and want to transition to full-time work focused on making sure AI systems are safe and beneficial for all of humanity. If you are a <strong>professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff-level engineer</strong> and want to transition to work on transformative AI, we want to hear from you. Background in machine learning is not required.</p> <h2><strong>What to expect</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A concrete, scoped project matched to your background, with direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers</li> <li>Access to Claude models and GPU compute</li> <li>Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Interview process</strong></h2> <p>The interview process will include an initial application, recruiter screen, technical assessment, research discussion and a reference check.</p> <p>Applications for this round close on November 22, 2026 (11:59 PM PT). We expect to make offers in January 2027.</p> <h2><strong>You may be a good fit if you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Are motivated by making sure AI is safe and beneficial for society as a whole</li> <li>Are excited to transition into working on empirical AI research full-time</li> <li>Have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields (professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff-level engineer)</li> <li>Thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments</li> <li>Can implement ideas quickly and communicate clearly</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Strong candidates may also</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Have experience authoring research papers in machine learning, NLP, or AI safety</li> <li>Have experience with LLMs, reinforcement learning or Kubernetes clusters and complex shared codebases</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Mentors and research areas</strong></h2> <p>Potential Anthropic mentors include:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/sara-price-310757b2/">Sara Price</a>: leads the Alignment Training team; background in data science</li> <li><a href="https://ethanperez.net/">Ethan Perez</a>: leads the Alignment Science team; background in machine learning</li> <li><a href="https://evhub.github.io/">Evan Hubinger</a>: leads the Alignment Stress-Testing team; formerly at The Machine Intelligence Research Institute (MIRI)</li> <li><a href="https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=fW7yK10AAAAJ&hl=en">Samuel Marks</a>: leads the Scalable Oversight team; background in mathematics</li> <li><a href="https://elanapearl.github.io/">Elana Simon</a>: researches the interpretability of language models and biological models; background in biomedical informatics</li> <li><a href="https://belindal.github.io/">Belinda Li</a>: researches how language models represent the world, users, and themselves; background in natural language processing (PhD, MIT)</li> <li><a href="https://jlindsey15.github.io/">Jack Lindsey</a>: leads the Model Psychology team; background in theoretical neuroscience</li> <li><a href="https://nicholas.carlini.com/">Nicholas Carlini</a>: researches adversarial machine learning and AI security; previously at DeepMind and Google Brain</li> <li><a href="https://sohldickstein.com/">Jascha Sohl-Dickstein</a>: works at the intersection of safety and pretraining; background in physics and neuroscience, formerly Principal Scientist at Google Brain</li> </ul> <p>Residents will work on empirical research questions in collaboration with Anthropic's research teams. Areas we are particularly interested in include:</p> <p>AI safety & alignment</p> <ul> <li>Scalable Oversight: Developing techniques to keep highly capable models helpful and honest, even as they surpass human-level intelligence in various domains.</li> <li>Adversarial Robustness and AI Control: Creating methods to ensure advanced AI systems remain safe and harmless in unfamiliar or adversarial scenarios.</li> <li>Model Organisms: Creating <a href="https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/ChDH335ckdvpxXaXX/model-organisms-of-misalignment-the-case-for-a-new-pillar-of-1">model organisms of misalignment</a> to improve our empirical understanding of how alignment failures might arise.</li> <li>Model Internals and Interpretability: Advancing our understanding of the internal workings of large language models to enable more targeted interventions and safety measures.</li> <li>Safeguards Research: Developing robust defenses against adversarial attacks, comprehensive evaluation frameworks for model safety, and automated systems to detect and mitigate potential risks before deployment.</li> <li>AI Welfare: Improving our understanding of potential AI welfare and developing related evaluations and mitigations.</li> </ul> <p>AI security & frontier red-teaming</p> <ul> <li>Stress-testing frontier models to understand the full extent of their current capabilities in fields such as cybersecurity, robotics or cryptography.</li> </ul> <p>ML systems & reinforcement learning</p> <ul> <li>Improving how frontier models are trained and building the infrastructure behind that research, from model architecture, optimizers and training data to accelerator simulators, hardware backends and RL environment pipelines.</li> </ul> <p>For a fuller picture of the questions we care about, see our <a href="https://alignment.anthropic.com/2025/recommended-directions/">Recommendations for Technical AI Safety Research Directions</a> and recent publications from our <a href="https://alignment.anthropic.com/">Alignment</a>, <a href="https://transformer-circuits.pub/">Interpretability</a> and <a href="https://red.anthropic.com/">Frontier Red</a> teams.</p> <h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Duration:</strong> Placements are six weeks, three months or six months, depending on team fit and candidate preferences. Other lengths between three and six months are possible by exception.</li> <li><strong>Location:</strong> This application is for a remote UK position, with the option to work from our London office. However, we prefer that Residents work from our San Francisco office, where most of our research staff is based, but remote participation is possible, especially for shorter placements. Most full-time research roles at Anthropic require relocation to San Francisco. Remote participants need to be based in a country where Anthropic can hire.</li> <li><strong>Commitment:</strong> Full-time role for the duration of the residency.</li> <li><strong>Compensation:</strong> £265,000 to £375,000/year pro-rated for the duration of the residency + benefits</li> <li><strong>Visa sponsorship:</strong> We sponsor visas for placements of three months or longer. For six-week placements we encourage remote participation from a country where Anthropic can hire.</li> </ul> <p>Applicants may also be considered for the <a href="https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic/jobs/5183044008">Anthropic Fellows Program</a>.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. </p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£265,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£375,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study: </strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong> We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit <u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/career

title: Founding Account Executive (Italian Speaker)
description: About Sona Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here ( https://www.sona.ai/careers ). About the Role We're hiring a Founding Account Executive to win Sona's first customers in Italy and open the market for us. This is a senior, seller-first role, and you'll run every conversation with prospects in Italian, from the first call to the close. Our expansion into Europe is starting now and ramps up through 2027 across key markets. Italy is one of them, and you'll own the go-to-market launch there. Colleagues across Sona will be running the product, operations and other launch activities, so your focus is winning customers, building partnerships and creating the collateral to sell. With no sales team in market yet, you'll work with less support than a typical AE, and the team around you will grow as the market does. Day to day, you'll decide which Retail and Hospitality accounts to go after, from mid-market through to enterprise, and run consultative sales conversations yourself. You'll also build what a new market needs, including partnerships and Italian-language collateral. The platform is already localised for Italy, and you'll have product and solutions support. It's early, and the ground will shift as we learn what works. If you want a structured environment with lots of support around you, this won't be the right fit. If you want to shape how Sona sells in Italy from the start, it could be exactly that. The role is office-based in London, with travel to Italy as needed. Responsibilities Lead the go-to-market launch in Italy and win Sona's first customers, taking each deal from first conversation to close. Build your own pipeline across Retail and Hospitality, from mid-market to enterprise. Run strategic, consultative sales conversations in Italian. Build and run partnerships that open doors in the Italian market. Create the collateral Sona needs to sell in Italy. Work with Sona's Strategy and Expansion Lead on where to focus and how to approach the market. Feed what you learn from the market back to our Commercial and Product teams. Travel to Italy as the role requires. Requirements You're a native Italian speaker, comfortable selling and negotiating in Italian, with fluent English for working with colleagues in London. You have a senior Account Executive track record of winning new business, ideally across mid-market and enterprise deals. You have a founder mentality. You take ownership, make decisions with limited information, and are happy building without a playbook. You're strategic and consultative in how you sell, and you work well independently with less support than most AEs get. You're comfortable creating partnerships and collateral from scratch. You're based in London, or able to be, and happy to travel to Italy as the role needs. Strongly preferred: Spanish, French or German as an additional language. It doesn't replace Italian. Flexibility : We have office hubs in London and Boston, as well as no-office hubs in several European countries. We operate a choice-first work approach that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near an office hub. Salary : We benchmarked £45,000 + equity at IC2 in our progression framework for someone based in the UK. Let us know in your application if you like the look of the role but the salary doesn’t match what you’re looking for. Interviews : 2 stages totalling around 2.5 hours over 2 weeks, plus some prep for a task. Start date : As soon as you can start. Reporting to : Ryan, Interim Finance Director (while Eimear, Finance Director, is on leave) More info : The FAQ below, juro.com/careers , our handbook or ask ----- style="min-height:1.5em"> HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER Juro has big ambitions: to make it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts. And we'll need help doing it . Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity. Juro bills customers and pays suppliers across UK and US entities, and the volume keeps growing. We’re looking for someone who carries the day-to-day weight of finance operations together with the team. Roughly 60% of your week goes on AP/AR, and the rest is month-end and reporting support: reconciliations, revenue review, and pulling together what’s needed for statutory accounts, audit requests and VAT returns. You won’t be doing this alone: you’ll work closely with Charlotte, our Financial Controller, who owns the close, and Ryan, our Interim Finance Director (stepping in for Eimear), who leads the Finance function. Your mission is to: Own invoicing, payables and collections end-to-end so Juro gets paid efficiently, accurately and with strong control of cash, and support month-end so leadership can trust the numbers. Success looks like: Invoices done right first time: Contracts are turned into accurate invoices with minimal rework or back-and-forth with Sales and Customer Success. Money moving smoothly: Customers pay on time and suppliers are paid accurately across our UK and US entities. You keep an up-to-date view of what’s owed in and out, and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) comes down over time. Reliable month-end support: Your reconciliations are accurate and on time, you flag escalations early, and you contribute to month-end, revenue review and statutory reporting. Solid, scalable ops: Processes are well controlled (from supplier onboarding and bank detail checks to payment run approvals), audit-ready, and increasingly automated inside Rillet (our ERP) and Ramp (our spend management system). You improve the process notes rather than just following them. We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub . WHO WE LOOK FOR Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit. To succeed here: Every Juror finds their balance across our four principles . We hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day. Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles. On top of that, you have been part of a journey where: You’ve done both AR and AP: raising invoices, handling billing queries, chasing payments or paying suppliers. You’ve been the #1 point of contact for customers or suppliers on billing and payments. You can be firm about an overdue balance without damaging the relationship, and you keep Sales, CS and budget holders in the loop. You’ve helped with a month-end, e.g. by doing bank or ledger reconciliations. You’ve used finance systems day to day (NetSuite, Rillet, Xero, Ramp or similar) and pick up new tools quickly. You read contracts carefully enough to know what should be invoiced, when, and what’s unclear, and you work with Sales and CS to get it right. You notice repetitive manual work and want to fix it, whether that’s with a better spreadsheet, an automation or AI. Bonus points if: You’ve worked with SaaS contracts or subscription billing. You’ve helped with VAT returns, US sales tax, revenue reporting or audit requests. You’ve worked in a multi-entity (UK/US) business with multi-currency invoicing. This job likely isn’t for you if: You’re mainly looking for formal accounting training or a pathway to becoming ACA-qualified. You want to own the month-end close or focus on technical accounting, rather than a hands-on mix of finance operations and reporting support. You prefer clearly defined, static processes and don’t enjoy owning messy, real-world problems and making them better (especially with AI). OUR MISSION Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts. The load on legal teams is increasing as business teams move faster with the help of AI. The only way out is to deploy AI within the legal team so that (a) routine contract work can be executed autonomously and (b) lawyers’ time is reserved for problem solving. It’s like having an extra team member that is always on and takes on heavy lifting. Just like an in-house lawyer, Juro: is present for, and trusted by, business teams owns contracts from first draft to signature and beyond builds judgement from every contract it works on …all within guardrails controlled by the legal team. title: AI Software Engineer
description: About Us TrustFlight is the Aerospace Safety Intelligence Platform - the only company in aviation that integrates safety and security technology, world-class training and consulting, and emergency preparedness and response into a single, connected platform. We serve 1,600+ organisations across 120 countries through four capability pillars: TrustFlight (technology), Baines Simmons (training and expertise), Redline Assured Security (security), and Kenyon International (emergency response). We’re entering a new phase of growth. Smart Suite, our AI-powered agentic platform, is redefining how aerospace organisations manage safety, compliance, and operational risk. Our go-to-market needs to keep pace. Why Choose TrustFlight? ✈️ Our Mission : To revolutionize aviation by delivering digital workflow solutions that enhance safety, streamline operations, and inspire confidence across the industry. ✈️ Impact : Over 200,000 users rely on our systems daily, making aviation safer and more efficient. ✈️ Core Values : Guided by integrity, responsibility, innovation, and excellence, we are committed to empowering our partners to operate with confidence. Join us in shaping the future of aviation and making an impact through technology. The Role You will join TrustFlight as an AI Software Engineer and serve as a core member of the AI Team. In this role, you will work closely within the team and cross-functionally across the organization to design, build, and deliver high-impact AI-powered software solutions. This is an opportunity for a self-motivated, creative engineer who enjoys taking ideas from early exploration through technical planning, implementation, deployment, and iteration in production. The role is software engineering first, with a strong emphasis on applying AI thoughtfully and effectively to real business problems. You will help build full-stack AI applications, backend services that provide AI capabilities to other products and users, and integrations that embed AI directly into existing applications and workflows. You will also help strengthen the AI Team’s engineering approaches, contribute to sound architectural and implementation decisions, and support AI understanding across the organization by sharing practical use cases, guidance, and best practices. What you’ll be doing Drive the full lifecycle of AI/ML solutions, from research and prototyping through production deployment, evaluation, and monitoring. Design and implement scalable, maintainable systems with strong software engineering fundamentals, using sound architecture, infrastructure, and design patterns. Help shape the AI team's software engineering practices by contributing to technical direction, improving implementation approaches, and ensuring solutions are built in a reliable, maintainable, and scalable way. Collaborate cross-functionally to develop and optimize AI-powered product features and internal tools. Build, orchestrate, and integrate LLM-based systems into production applications. Apply AI patterns and frameworks such as RAG, skills, document extraction, and workflow orchestration where they are the right fit. Refine AI use cases through prompt engineering, evaluation, guardrails, and orchestration strategies. Assess where AI can streamline or improve existing processes, and identify cases where conventional software solutions are a better choice. Support AI adoption across the organization by helping teams understand, use, and implement AI effectively in their day-to-day work. What you’ll bring Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 2–3+ years of professional experience shipping production software, with strong engineering fundamentals. Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to deliver full-stack changes across backend services, web applications, and Python-based systems. Experience building and shipping production-quality software with attention to reliability, maintainability, testing, and performance. Experience delivering AI features into production, including working with LLM APIs and building reliable AI workflows with considerations such as latency, streaming, retries, fallbacks, and error handling. Strong understanding of the capabilities, trade-offs, and limitations of modern AI systems. Clear communication, strong ownership, and the ability to operate effectively in a small team. A growth mindset, with a willingness to learn, adapt, and continuously improve technical and product skills. What makes you stand out Strong background in software development, with experience contributing across the product and engineering lifecycle. Experience integrating and implementing AI features, automations, or products in a professional environment. Comfort working with LLM provider SDKs, APIs, and common abstractions such as PydanticAI, LangChain, or LiteLLM. Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and develop practical solutions. Experience leading projects, mentoring teammates, or helping raise engineering standards. Location This role is based in our Vancouver office. This is an on-site role with room for flexibility, because we know life doesn't always fit a 9-to-5 mould. Why join us See Your Impact : Your contributions directly enhance the safety and efficiency of aviation operations, affecting hundreds of thousands of passengers and crew every month. Build and Create : Be part of an environment where you'll have the freedom to innovate, build, and create solutions that define the future of digital aviation. Growth Opportunity : Join us at an inflection point as we scale our revenue growth using cutting-edge AI tools and SaaS best practices. Also, we offer Health & Wellness : Comprehensive benefits package including health and dental benefits. Paid time off plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. Invest in your future : Take advantage of our company contribution to pension/RRSP matching program to grow your savings while you work. Professional Growth : As a fast-growing company, we offer incredible opportunities for career advancement and skill development. Competitive salary range : We place huge importance on the contribution and experience you bring to the team. The base pay offered is based on location and may vary depending on skills, job related knowledge, experience and internal equity. The expected base salary range for this role is $110,000 to $160,000 CAD, depending on skills and experience. $110K–$120K: Solid software engineering experience with some hands-on experience building or integrating AI/LLM-powered features. Candidates can contribute effectively to production software and have practical familiarity with AI-enabled workflows, though they may not yet have deep experience delivering complex AI systems. $120K–$130K: Strong software engineering experience with solid applied AI experience, or stronger AI experience paired with solid software engineering fundamentals. Candidates can design, build, and ship production software that includes AI-powered features, applying sound judgment across reliability, maintainability, and user impact. $130K–$145K: Proven ability to design, build, and deliver production-grade systems that combine strong software engineering fundamentals with applied AI expertise. title: Regional Director of Operations, UK, Europe and Africa
description: Regional Director of Operations, UK, Europe and Africa Kenyon International Emergency Services, part of the TrustFlight Group Bracknell, United Kingdom | Full time, permanent | Competitive salary and benefits package When the worst happens, families need someone they can trust. Lead that response. When an aircraft is lost, a ship is in distress or a community is struck by disaster, families are suddenly facing the hardest days of their lives. They need answers, they need to be treated with dignity, and they need to know that the people they have lost are being cared for. For more than a century, Kenyon International Emergency Services has been the organisation that airlines, governments and major companies call on to make sure that happens. We are looking for a senior crisis leader to direct that response across the UK, Europe and Africa. This is a role for someone who has stood in the room when it mattered, who leads with calm authority, and who believes that how an organisation treats the bereaved and the injured says everything about its character. About Kenyon Kenyon provides emergency planning, family assistance, humanitarian support and recovery services to clients around the world, drawing on a network of more than 2,500 trained responders who can be mobilised at short notice into any jurisdiction. Our clients rely on us to keep their promises to the people affected by an incident, and we hold ourselves to that standard every day, not only on the day of an activation. Kenyon is part of the TrustFlight Group, an aviation safety and compliance technology business. That gives Kenyon something unusual in this sector: a world class technology team working alongside it, and a genuine commitment to using AI to make crisis response faster, better informed and more humane. Our values are simple and we mean them: integrity, and a customer first attitude in everything we do. The role Kenyon operates a two hub leadership model. You will lead the Bracknell hub, with regional accountability for operational delivery, readiness, contracted offices and relationships across the UK, Europe and Africa. Your peer, the Regional Director of Operations in Vancouver, leads the Americas and Asia Pacific. Together you share accountability for the readiness and quality of Kenyon’s response worldwide. Senior Incident Director for activations Senior on call duty is shared between the two Directors on a fixed twelve hour rota, with a structured handover at each change of duty, so that cover is continuous around the clock and neither Director works through their own night. Your window runs from approximately 06:00 to 18:00 UK time. When an incident arises during your window, wherever in the world it occurs, you take up the role of Senior Incident Director. You will have the authority to set the deployment posture, commit responders and stand the organisation up or down without further approval. Where a client requires it, you will deploy as their strategic point of contact, leading the response on their behalf at the most demanding moments an organisation can face, including mass casualty, government led and politically sensitive events. Major activations are infrequent, and Kenyon holds its capability through a surge based model rather than a large permanent workforce. Your judgement of regional readiness, kept current every week of the year, is what makes that model work. What you will lead · Regional readiness and response. Maintain and continuously measure activation readiness across the UK, Europe and Africa, and develop the procedures, protocols and contingency plans that underpin it. · Your team and offices. Line manage the Regional Operations Manager in Bracknell, run the Bracknell hub and its regional operations as one regional function, and hold contracted offices to defined standards through quarterly reviews and an annual assessment. · Protecting those we serve. Make sure the information of casualties, families and clients is protected with the same care during and after an activation as on any other day. · The responder network. Work with the Responder Manager to keep the network vetted, trained and available across the region, including building language capable responders across Europe and Africa. Own the global standards for responder vetting, training currency, deployment conduct and post incident review, ensuring they are consistently applied across both hubs. · AI and digital quality assurance. Work with the Vancouver Director and TrustFlight Group technology team to define and evaluate AI enabled quality and operational reporting tools, including an AI internal auditor supporting ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 22300 evidence gathering, gap identification and audit trail maintenance. Ensure these tools meet group information security, data governance and ethical standards. · Global operational standards. Work with the Vancouver Director to compare regional procedures, share lessons learned and adopt improvements across both hubs, ensuring consistent service quality while recognising regional operational requirements. · Relationships that matter. Build trusted working relationships with government agencies, emergency services, aviation authorities and clients across the region, and provide the operational insight that informs board level reporting. Why join us · Work that matters. Few roles offer the chance to lead a service whose sole purpose is to bring order, care and dignity to people at the worst moment of their lives. · Real authority. A senior seat on the Kenyon leadership team, reporting to the Managing Director, with decision making authority during activations. · A sustainable model. A shared rota designed so that no Director carries standing 24/7 availability, because sound judgement depends on rest. · Room to build. The opportunity to shape Kenyon’s growth across the UK, Europe and Africa, while leading the development of global quality, certification and responder standards and helping shape how AI strengthens operational assurance across Kenyon. In your cover letter, tell us about an incident you have led and what it taught you about caring for the people affected. Applications will be treated in strict confidence. Kenyon International Emergency Services and TrustFlight are equal opportunity employers. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process for anyone who needs them. This position is employed by Kenyon International Emergency Services Limited. What you will bring · At least ten years in operational crisis management or emergency response, including five or more in a leadership role. · Experience leading large scale or complex incident responses in international environments, ideally including direct responsibility for strategic command. · A track record of managing contracted service providers against defined performance standards. · Experience working within a quality management framework in a regulated or standards led environment, and alongside board level governance. · The composure, judgement and compassion to lead when the stakes are highest, and the humility to put the needs of affected families first. · Willingness to travel internationally at short notice, including to the United States and across Asia Pacific. · Eligibility to live and work in the UK. It would be a real advantage if you also have · Professional fluency in Spanish, or another principal European and African language. · Familiarity with the ISO 22300 series, including ISO 22320, or equivalent certification experience. · Experience overseeing a 24/7 contact centre operation. · Practical experience commissioning AI or automation tools in an operational setting. · Knowledge of the aviation, maritime, energy or government crisis response markets in the Europe and Africa. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role</span></strong></h3> <p>Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.</p> <p>When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.</p> <p>The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.</p> <p>The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.</p> <p>In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.</p> <p>This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Your responsibilities will include:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true}"> </span></p> <ul> <li>Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. title: Head of Solution Consulting R&D / Field CSO
description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW R&D leaders trust people who have done the science. More than half of the world's top 50 biopharma companies already use Benchling, and many of the most important are in Europe. Our ambition is 10x faster science, from idea to first dose. With Science Foundries, launched at Benchtalk 2026, agents and scientists run entire R&D workflows together, so a three-person team can have the productive capacity of thirty. In a senior R&D role, you can change how one organisation does science. As our Field CSO, you'll take one question to R&D organisations across EMEA: how do we get from idea to first dose 10x faster? ROLE OVERVIEW You'll lead our EMEA R&D Solution Consulting organisation: a team of 12, with two first-line leaders covering our Enterprise and Strategic segments, plus occasional support for APAC deals. You'll be the scientific counterpart to our General Manager, EMEA, and work alongside our Field CTO. They lead on IT, data science and architecture; you lead on the scientists and how their work changes. RESPONSIBILITIES Be the scientific voice in the room. Brief the GM and account teams before key meetings, then join them as a peer to the CSOs and Heads of R&D across the table. Act as senior sponsor on our largest EMEA opportunities, and use account-team introductions to open new R&D relationships. Lead the 10x conversation. Turn Benchling's vision, from AI agents to Science Foundries, into a credible plan R&D leaders can act on, including how their scientists move onto Benchling and what changes in the lab. Lead and develop two first-line leaders and their team of 10. Provide in-region leadership continuity, set the scientific bar for every customer engagement, and build a succession plan as the team grows. Shape EMEA strategy and the roadmap. Decide with sales leadership where to focus the team's expertise, and bring patterns from the field back to Product, Marketing and global Solution Consulting. HOW WE'LL MEASURE SUCCESS This is a commercial role with a scientific core. We'll look at EMEA revenue growth and influenced pipeline, technical win rate, forecast accuracy on the technical side of deals, regional ownership of our largest R&D relationships, and the strength of your leadership bench. QUALIFICATIONS Substantial hands-on R&D experience in biotech or pharma, with a PhD or equivalent scientific depth. You've run experiments, led programmes and know how large R&D organisations make decisions and adopt change. A record of driving change, from adopting new technologies to rethinking how your teams work, and clear views on how AI will change R&D. Experience leading through other managers, and executive presence with VPs, Heads of R&D and C-level leaders. Commercial ambition and a growth mindset. We'll teach you how software is sold. We can't teach how a large R&D organisation works from the inside, and that's what you bring. Readiness for a field role: frequent on-site time with the largest pharma and biotech companies across EMEA, plus US travel three to four times a year for team offsites and our global sales kickoff. Fluency in English; German or French is a plus. NICE TO HAVE Experience with Benchling or a comparable R&D platform (ELN, LIMS or R&D data platform), including leading its evaluation or rollout Customer-facing scientific, internal consulting, or CRO/CDMO programme leadership roles Presales or solution consulting experience HOW WE WORK We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday). #LI-Hybrid #BI-Hybrid Benchling welcomes everyone. We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.
